### Biography

Dr. Praveen B. Roylawar is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Botany at S.N. Arts, D.J.M. Commerce & B.N.S. Science College (Autonomous), Sangamner. His research focuses on understanding plant–microbiome interactions and their applications in sustainable agriculture, plant health, and environmental resilience.

His research integrates microbiology, plant pathology, molecular biology, metagenomics, transcriptomics, and bioinformatics to investigate beneficial plant-associated microorganisms and their role in improving crop productivity and stress tolerance.

He actively collaborates with national and international research institutions and is committed to developing innovative microbiome-based solutions for sustainable crop production.

His current research aims to translate microbiome science into sustainable agricultural practices through interdisciplinary research and international collaborations.
